Acceptance on the platform is not a platform-guaranteed service contract or payment commitment. Agree scope, fees, deliverables, payment method, invoicing/tax obligations, and other commercial terms separately in writing with the other party.

onboarding.howItWorksSubtitle: A direct, transparent 3-step pathway engineered for both project owners and software engineers.
onboarding.clientStep1Desc: Specify scope, tech stack, and budget. Your listing remains active on our freshness radar for 7 days.
onboarding.clientStep2Desc: Review 1-to-1 proposals encrypted with AES-256 that only you can see. Your contact info remains private.
onboarding.clientStep3Desc: Accept the best proposal, unlock direct contact channels, and work peer-to-peer with 0% platform fee.
onboarding.freelancerStep1Desc: Follow your engineering disciplines and track fresh opportunities within the strict 1-week window.
onboarding.freelancerStep2Desc: Your proposals are never visible to competitors. No public bidding wars or race-to-the-bottom pricing.
onboarding.freelancerStep3Desc: Connect directly once your offer is accepted. Keep 100% of your earnings with zero platform cuts.
onboarding.faqSubtitle: Clear, transparent answers about our operational rules and direct model.
onboarding.authHeroTitle: A New Era for Software Collaboration
onboarding.authHeroSubtitle: Eliminating platform cuts, escrow overhead, and bidding wars forever.
onboarding.zeroCommissionDesc: No fee is taken from project owners or engineers. All matches are 100% direct and commission-free.
onboarding.dualRoleDesc: No separate accounts needed. Use the same profile to both hire software talent and submit project proposals.
onboarding.privacyGuaranteedDesc: Proposals are encrypted; phone and email contact details are only revealed upon bilateral match acceptance.
onboarding.sevenDayRuleDesc: Stale or abandoned listings expire automatically; you will only ever interact with active projects.
